common.goal_conditioning: the behavior policy and every learned value used by that policy receive the commanded goal; all-goal auxiliary heads must retain per-goal terminal semantics
common.action_semantics: use each canonical environment's full action enum; environment-invalid actions remain no-op and are not masked unless a later audited environment contract explicitly changes that rule; behavior and targets use the same action set
common.terminal_semantics: world reset is terminal for all goals; achieving a goal is terminal for that goal; command switching alone is not terminal for another goal
common.physical_vs_valid: environment steps and learning-eligible transitions are counted separately
common.implementation_freeze: architecture, losses, optimizers, schedules, target updates, replay rules, and initialization must be complete and hashed before any normal-only development result is observed

GC-PQN.family: goal-conditioned parallelized Q-network online learner with neither a replay buffer nor a target network
GC-PQN.behavior: epsilon behavior is a training/sampling view; greedy behavior is a separately reported deterministic evaluation view
GC-PQN.targets: online Q-learning or Q(lambda) targets are computed from the frozen rollout batch with the current online network; the exact Q(lambda) choice and lambda must be predeclared per candidate
GC-PQN.replay_retention: none; frozen online rollout batches may be reused only for the predeclared number of optimizer steps and are not carried across updates

LEO.family: standalone goal-conditioned all-goal Q learner acting from its own Q policy
LEO.behavior: epsilon behavior is a training/sampling view; greedy behavior is the deterministic primary evaluation view
LEO.targets: each valid physical transition may supply predeclared per-goal TD targets; a goal head bootstraps until that goal is achieved or the world resets
LEO.replay_retention: none; frozen online rollout batches may be reused only for the predeclared number of optimizer steps and are not carried across updates

Dual LEO(PQN).family: separately parameterized LEO and goal-conditioned UVFA/PQN Q learners trained with their own TD objectives
Dual LEO(PQN).behavior: the licensed purejaxgcrl contract at eafccd995ac2736df5fbc05ac4bb6b5d58cfcce7 combines LEO and UVFA Q-values for action selection
Dual LEO(PQN).candidate_rule: acting mode and weight must be explicitly frozen for every candidate; the upstream default is linear combination with LEO weight 0.3
Dual LEO(PQN).targets: LEO and UVFA/PQN TD targets and losses remain separate and are both logged; the LEO head uses per-goal terminal semantics
Dual LEO(PQN).pqn_target_network: none; the PQN component follows the online no-target-network contract
Dual LEO(PQN).ppo_style_behavior_cloning: not part of this Phase-1 Dual LEO(PQN) specification; do not introduce or describe PPO-style behavior cloning unless a later licensed source-conformance audit establishes and freezes a different contract
Dual LEO(PQN).replay_retention: none; frozen online rollout batches may be reused only for the predeclared number of optimizer steps and are not carried across updates

GC-SD-SAC.family: goal-conditioned Stable Discrete SAC independently specified from Discrete SAC arXiv:1910.07207 and the entropy-penalty, double-average Q-learning, and Q-clip contract in arXiv:2209.10081
GC-SD-SAC.actor: a goal-conditioned categorical policy over the canonical environment's full discrete action enum
GC-SD-SAC.critics: two goal-conditioned local Q critics and two Polyak-updated target critics; do not substitute the vanilla clipped-min target for the published Stable Discrete SAC double-average contract
GC-SD-SAC.critic_target: reward plus discounted nonterminal average of the two target-critic policy values at the next state, with exact categorical expectation over the canonical action enum and terminal masking from the common contract
GC-SD-SAC.q_clip: each critic uses the published max-of-two squared-error Q-clip loss with its local-to-target Q change clipped to [-c,c]; c, reductions, gradient stops, and Polyak tau must be frozen from the published equation before implementation
GC-SD-SAC.stored_entropy: store the behavior policy entropy H_old with every replay transition, as required by the published entropy-penalty contract
GC-SD-SAC.actor_objective: exact categorical expectation over the canonical action enum of alpha*log(policy)-Q_actor plus beta/2*(H_old-H_current)^2; the two-critic Q_actor aggregation, beta, reductions, and gradient stops must be frozen from the published equation before implementation
GC-SD-SAC.temperature: automatic entropy-temperature optimization is part of the method; its target entropy, loss sign, bounds, and schedule must be frozen in the implementation audit
learning_state: two critic parameter sets and optimizers
replay contents, cursor, capacity, and sampling counters
GC-SD-SAC.replay_retention: retain the completed fixed-normal pretraining replay snapshot at the fork; clone identical contents, cursor, capacity, and sampler state into fixed and mutant branches; thereafter use identical eviction and sampling rules without cross-branch sharing

development.seed_rule: both seeds are required independently in every method x environment cell

configuration_contract.cap_scope: one shared normal-only candidate registry per method across both environments; the cap is not multiplied by environment or cell
configuration_contract.environment_resolution: a candidate may contain a complete predeclared environment-keyed parameter table, but that table remains one candidate ID and may not be expanded after any result
configuration_contract.empty_registry_meaning: Phase 1 authorizes zero development runs. A reviewed amendment must freeze and hash no more than four complete normal-only configurations for a method before that method observes any development result.
candidate_requirements: a stable configuration ID and complete resolved hyperparameters
identical fixed-normal development evaluation layouts for all candidates of a method x environment cell
no field chosen from bug, exploitation, mutant, or final-evaluation evidence

selection.ordering: maximize each candidate's fixed-normal natural-start delivery success aggregated only across development seeds; break an exact success tie by fixed-normal return

gate.rule: each required development seed must individually achieve success >= 0.90
gate.common_setup_role: diagnostic only; it may not substitute for natural-start
gate.on_pass: open only this method x environment main cell, subject to a separately authorized execution manifest and capacity check
gate.on_failure: close only this method x environment main cell

final_exploratory.seed_independence: learner seed is the independent unit
final_exploratory.cross_algorithm_seed_note: The same numeric labels do not imply paired initialization across algorithms.
final_exploratory.failed_seed_policy: failed, collapsed, and incomplete-policy seeds remain included in denominators and seed-level reporting; operationally missing jobs are reported as missing, not silently dropped
final_exploratory.layout_freeze: held-out final layouts and their hashes must be fixed before any development or final run and may not participate in configuration selection
final_exploratory.claims: descriptive, seed-level exploratory outcomes for the frozen selected method x environment configuration only
final_exploratory.not_claimed: not confirmatory replication, not a cross-algorithm paired-seed estimate, not authority to retune, and not evidence about unopened or failed-gate cells
final_exploratory.future_confirmatory_use: any confirmatory claim, extra seed, or new hypothesis requires a new preregistered manifest

budget.transition_unit: physical environment transitions; valid transitions, replay samples, TD targets, and optimizer steps are separate compute counters and never replace this budget unit

separate_categories.normal_ability: fixed-kernel natural-start delivery success and return
separate_categories.trigger: whether the state/event that makes the defect behavior available is reached
separate_categories.exploit: whether the policy uses the defect conditional on its opportunity

separate_categories.actual_value: task return or delivered value under the named kernel and evaluation view
separate_categories.discovery_interval: first-to-last checkpoint interval consistent with first observed discovery; not an interpolated discovery time
separate_categories.maintenance: whether separately defined discovered behavior persists at later checkpoints
separate_categories.failure: normal inability, missing trigger, no exploit, lost maintenance, collapse, operational failure, and missing job remain distinct failure labels

stop_contracts: Phase 1 stops before any smoke, training, queue launch, checkpoint write, or dependency installation.
A failed development gate closes only its method x environment cell and cannot be extended automatically.
A capacity forecast that cannot preserve the required reserve stops the affected run before checkpoint writing.
Capacity erosion during an authorized future run triggers a safe resumable stop and verified migration.
NaN/Inf, state-fingerprint mismatch, branch asymmetry, budget overrun, or missing required logging stops the affected cell and preserves its failure record.
No failed seed, condition, or required final state may be deleted to make a summary complete.
